ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% high-intensity white/off-white pixels to 20% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity border along the trailing edge and lateral tips; a prominent vertical dark line extending from the median notch toward the peduncle; yellowish-tan staining clusters in the medial regions of both lobes; scattered dark micro-spots throughout the white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 65-degree internal angle and high vertical depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with high pixel-amplitude along the distal sections of the trailing edge; transition to lower-amplitude irregular undulations approaching the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a strong convex curvature tapering to sharp, upward-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white calcified clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips; scattered dark circular pixel clusters on the upper-right and left-center lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear marks (rake marks) visible crossing the white pigmentation, notably on the right lobe near the median notch and on the lower-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake marks on the right lobe; significant barnacle colonization on the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized yellowish-brown bio-staining on the medial-lower regions of both fluke lobes, contrasting with the primary white pigmentation.
